theme: A caregiving Wednesday in Maine, tilting toward Mike's surgery tomorrow.
greeting: A spread-out day, Dan — Mike's scans this morning and afternoon, a Tokyo call tonight, and a runway to clear before tomorrow's oral surgery. The girls are with Jen, so it's just the two of you.

needsAttention.title: Mike's surgery prep
needsAttention.detail: Oral surgery is tomorrow in Portland, so today is the last real window to fill prescriptions, stock soft foods, and lay in ice packs and gauze. The prep task is running overdue in Todoist.

needsAttention.title: IMC research call with Chie and Mike
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow at 9 PM ET (Friday 10 AM in Tokyo) you, Mike Lubrano, and Chie Mitsui talk through the next stage of IMC research. Worth arriving with a view on Mike's idea to reach Sustainalytics' newly abandoned stewardship clients.

flagged.title: Mastercard exec wants to connect
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn invite from Mastercard's Chief Government Affairs & Policy Officer is waiting on your response.

flagged.title: NACD reception RSVP
flagged.detail: NACD New England's Sept. 15 Appreciation Reception asked you to reply if you can join.

flagged.title: Dubrovnik flight confirmed
flagged.detail: Underpricer confirmed your booking to Dubrovnik — worth a glance at the dates and fare.

flagged.title: Maine ferry tickets confirmed
flagged.detail: Your Maine State Ferry reservation and tickets came through.

inbox.noise: Newsletters and promos — Midcoast Villager, Portland Water District, a Nautilus Sailing pitch — plus your own daily Japanese lessons.
inbox.clear: Warm personal notes from Dan Mac on boats and Amra at BlackRock, neither needing a reply today.

resolved.title: IMC call is locked in
resolved.detail: Mike sent the Teams invite and you confirmed Thursday night; tomorrow's 9 PM ET slot is set.

resolved.title: Sustainalytics question answered
resolved.detail: Amra at BlackRock replied yesterday with her read on the Morningstar/Sustainalytics stewardship wind-down.

recipe.title: Olive oil–poached zucchini & raw tomatoes
recipe.why: Late-August zucchini and tomatoes are at their peak — poach the squash gently in good oil and let raw summer tomatoes carry the plate.

acts.line: You're with Mike for a 9:30 throat ultrasound, then late morning and lunch stay open.
A 3:30 MRI and a 5 o'clock haircut sit either side of a quiet middle.
An 8 PM Zoom with Jomon Associates in Tokyo, then a calm night before tomorrow's surgery.
